feeds.title: Art Observed
feeds.description: Art Observed covers contemporary art globally from a New York City perspective. We intend to provide a selective, editorialized, curated perspective on the fine art arena including the trends and forces that drive the market.

feeds.title: This Is Colossal
feeds.description: This is Colossal, founded in 2010 by Chicago-based editor Christopher Jobson, is an acclaimed blog that delves into the world of art and visual culture. Renowned for its extensive coverage of contemporary art, design, photography, and visual science, the blog features 15 to 25 posts weekly, showcasing a diverse array of creative expressions. Jobson, who transitioned from web design to full-time blogging in 2013, established Colossal as part of a personal challenge to accomplish 100 things in one year...

feeds.title: Hyperallergic
feeds.description: A forum for serious, playful, and radical perspectives on art & culture in the world today. Covers the latest art news, reviews, and commentary. Hyperallergic is an online arts magazine, based in Brooklyn, New York. Founded by the art critic Hrag Vartanian and his husband Veken Gueyikian in October 2009.

feeds.title: Spoke Art Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2010, Spoke Art is an exhibition space and curatorial venture specializing in new contemporary painting, sculpture, and illustration. The gallery puts on pop-up shows and participates in conventions and art fairs around the country. Get regular updates on exhibitions, releases, and special events.

feeds.title: Contemporary Art Daily
feeds.description: Selected contemporary art exhibitions from around the world, with new exhibitions posted each day.

feeds.title: The Other Side Of The Desk
feeds.description: The Other Side Of The Desk brings together critical reflections exploring the different strands of my interest including contemporary art and literature, reading as culture, and the life of the mind.

feeds.title: Akimbo Blog
feeds.description: Akimbo is a Toronto-based company that promotes contemporary visual art, video, new media and film locally, nationally and internationally.

feeds.title: Bottleneck Art Gallery
feeds.description: Contemporary art space located in the heart of Williamsburg, Brooklyn specializing in pop-culture, gig and alternative movie posters.

feeds.title: Minus Plato Classics and Modern/Contemporary Art
feeds.description: Minus Plato is a blog that explores the dynamic between ancient Greek and Roman literature and philosophy and modern and contemporary art. It highlights how vitality of contemporary creative processes offers a unique perspective on ancient cultures and how ancient thought in turn can still intervene in the present.

feeds.title: Lisa Call — Abstract Contemporary Textile Paintings Blog
feeds.description: Lisa Call creates bold geometric contemporary textile paintings composed of her richly colored hand dyed fabric. Her work is abstract but draws elements from many places: her love of the colors and geological forms of the southwest, repetition, pattern, and an attraction to human-made structures for containment such as fences and stone walls.

feeds.title: Jeffrey Hayes: Contemporary Still Life Paintings
feeds.description: Contemporary Still Lifes from Jeffrey Hayes

feeds.title: Michal Art Studio Blog
feeds.description: Artist of Hawaii, Michal Abramovitz creates unique, lush, magical, vibrant, joyful and beautiful art works, inspired by the Hawaiian Islands. Explore the vibrant world of Michal Art Studio Hanalei on Kauaʻi's north shore - Hawaii. Uncover the artist's unique creations and immerse yourself in a haven of artistic expression. Read our latest blog post for a glimpse into the studio's enchanting atmosphere and the inspiration behind Michal's masterpieces.

feeds.title: Joanna Gilbert Blog
feeds.description: Joanna Gilbert, a 2018 graduate with a Masters in Fine Art from UAL Chelsea College of Arts, earned distinction for her groundbreaking 'NOTHING TO BUY' body of work. Her bold, large-scale abstract pieces exude visceral energy, symbolizing freedom and limitless potential. Through recent exhibitions, press features, and studio updates, Joanna invites audiences to immerse themselves in the abstract art realm, witnessing her fearless and transformative artistic journey unfold.

feeds.title: An unending adventure in Art
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog!I am a contemporary artist, relocated to my hometown Pune,India after a stay of 22 years in West Africa. My choosen medium is acrylic. My paintings are characterized by the vivid colors used in it ,I believe color gives a person feeling and feeling is what life is about. All these are original works on canvas or paper.

feeds.description: Follow visual artist Julie Ahmad's blogs for the latest abstract art news and updates here! Julie is a Feminist Abstract artist who paints from intuition and a rooted sense of responsibility for social awareness by utilizing symbolism, color and expressive techniques.

feeds.title: Caiger Art Blog
feeds.description: Caiger Contemporary Art, founded by Carol Caiger, welcomes visitors to a relaxed and approachable gallery space, offering original artworks for both seasoned collectors and newcomers alike. The gallery's online platform, www.caigerart.com, presents an array of affordable and awe-inspiring contemporary art, including paintings, limited edition prints, and sculptures. Visitors can explore insightful tips on art buying and hanging, along with engaging stories about the artists and their creations. At Caiger Contemporary Art, finding the ideal artwork is an enjoyable and accessible experience.

feeds.title: Cambridge Contemporary Art Blog
feeds.description: Cambridge Contemporary Art, nestled near King's College, Cambridge, boasts a diverse collection of handmade prints, paintings, sculptures, and crafts. Since its establishment in 1990, the gallery has earned acclaim for its broad selection of high-quality artworks and innovative exhibitions featuring local, national, and international artists. With an open and welcoming atmosphere, visitors receive friendly assistance from knowledgeable staff, eager to share insights about the showcased artists and craftspeople.

feeds.title: OUDERKIRK on ART
feeds.description: OUDERKIRK on ART is an art blog highlighting the frequently overlooked art venues, artists, galleries, museums, and topics. The blog also documents Ashley Ouderkirk's journey navigating the art world.

feeds.title: Mari French : contemporary artworks
feeds.description: The inspiration for Mari French's energetic, yet intimate artworks range from the wild expanse of the Norfolk saltmarsh coast, to the dramatic ruins of a Cornish tin mine. Many of her artworks are inspired by the wild expanse of the north Norfolk salt marsh coast: the wind in the reeds, scribbled prints of waders on the sandbanks, light-filled marsh pools and the calls of geese.

feeds.title: Kumi Contemporary Blog
feeds.description: Kumi Contemporary, situated in London, serves as a premier gallery for Contemporary Japanese Art, spotlighting renowned artists like Takashi Murakami and Chiho Aoshima. It proudly features works by innovative talents within the Japanese art scene. As a specialist Japanese gallery, Kumi Contemporary offers an extensive selection of Japanese Pop Art and facilitates the acquisition of Contemporary Japanese Art. Visitors can explore the Takashi Murakami print shop, showcasing a curated collection of his iconic works.

feeds.description: Defining the world of contemporary art since 1962. Follow our feed for news and critiques of exhibitions in the visual arts, with a contemporary focus. Includes world news, critics' picks, live symposia, interviews, archives, event calendar, and links to related sites.
